scope: No new simulation or settings changes. Normalized quaternion matrices used only for diagnostics. Recover rigid root from body collider and current body bone; test other collider poses against current bone hierarchy. Velocity values are endpoint finite differences at nominal1/60s, not recorded linvel/angvel/contact-point velocities; impact impulses and manifold depths unavailable. FixedPre world poses excluded because they can retain prior cached world transforms until physics.step.
